proposed_facts.reason: Canonical accessors establish pre-guard object dereference. Removal clears reciprocal fighter bookkeeping only for a matching non-NULL owner, then clears item references before requesting removal; the fighter helper clears precisely the three stated fields.
The signature is void(Item_GObj*). GET_ITEM requires a valid object before the explicit guard, whereas NULL user data is safely excluded from teardown.
The correction accurately separates NULL-object undefined access from the guarded NULL-data path and preserves conditional fighter cleanup versus unconditional item-reference clearing.

The fighter caller supplies position, part, motion offset, facing and scale. The constructor ignores part and scale and obtains special attributes from the successfully created item's article data. The stored parent drives the later lifetime predicate and ownership-conditional cleanup.

contradictions.reason: Accept superseding all three removal nullability claims: GET_ITEM executes before the object guard and its accessor unconditionally dereferences gobj. NULL user data, unlike a NULL object, remains a supported no-teardown path.
Accept superseding the attribution of article attributes to Fire's arguments: the caller does not pass them; the constructor reads them from the new item's article data.

Accept deferral of the .data fact and both section-to-Fire links. Two source table entries with identical callbacks are supported, but exact compiled byte size and complete section-to-table identity require unavailable compiled evidence.
Accept deferral of the .sdata2 interpretation. The complete source does not establish compiled section contents or constant-pool semantics.
